Default base_year is '2022-23' (latest series, data from 2023 onwards). base_year='2011-12': Data from 2012 onwards; use for years before 2023. base_year='2004-05': Data from 2005 to 2017. base_year='1993-94': Historical data from 1994 to 2010.
